title: It takes two.
text: It takes two.. There is no way to put this tray down to load it!  Someone has to hold it, and someone has to load!  If all the glasses aren’t removed, you can’t put it down again without help.  It makes a nice picture to have it loaded with eight drinks and pass them, but if you’re stuck with one, how do you put it down to take that one out?  Maybe I’m missing something.

product_metadata.title: Mind Reader Acrylic, Built in Handles Serving Tray, Kitchen Storage, Barware, 8 Compartment Wine, One Size, Clear Glass Holder
features: Handles - Built in handles at the end allows you to carry your wine glasses from one end of the party to the other end, giving you the chance to serve 8 guest at once
Versatile - This acrylic wine glass holder allows you to either serve 8 wine glasses to your guest at once or either dry them all at once.
8 Compartments - Equipped with 8 compartment holes to allow you to carry/ hold 8 wine glasses at once
Durable Construction - Built to last with attention to detail and superior materials. The acrylic holder withstands a good amount of weight.
Easy to Maintain - The acrylic prevents dust build up and is simple to clean. Simply wipe clean with a damp cloth or disinfecting wipe. Keep it classy and modern with the see-through acrylic
description: Start your party off right with a glass of wine. As the host of the party you're used to going back and forth to the bar to serve your guest. Save yourself the trips by getting this acrylic wine glass holder that holds 8 wine glasses at once. Be stress free at your own party and take the time to enjoy it with this sturdy wine glass holder
